rules: Labels are original MNIST/Fashion-MNIST labels, considered in binary pairs.
The main 14x14 image is mixed with seven independent images from the same empirical class-pair image pool; all blocks have matching marginals.
A fixed unknown coordinate permutation hides the informative image. The same layout is shared across source and target tasks.
The learner receives no block identity or permutation. Hidden layout is used only for diagnostic/oracle controls.
Indexators choose 64 distinct input coordinates; codebook C[64,16] is trained afresh per task.
Source and target classes are disjoint. Source train, source query and source calibration images are separated.
Keep best quarter by source-query BCE within task and lineage split; perfect source accuracy is not required.
Report both ordinary-image controls and this distractor-image modification; do not call it the standard unmodified dataset benchmark.
Compare against multitask gradient pretraining with the same source observations, not only fresh dense gradient training.
